claims.classification_rationale: CLAUDE.md §3.2 explicitly lists Layer-3 components (Feature Builder, Index Suite, Regime Gate, Supervisor Engine, Decision Engine, Execution Layer) as 'planned only' and states: 'Planned components MUST NOT be described as existing implementation.' §4 confirms Phase B (Layer 3 Bootstrap) is 'allowed, not completed' and Phase C/D are future/blocked. §10 forbids claiming 'Layer 3 is implemented' without explicit proof. This negative guard is directly and strongly verified by multiple constitutional sections.
notes: This guard protects against unsupported_current_state_claim violations

claims.claim_text: Live execution is NOT ready — this must not be claimed
claims.classification_rationale: CLAUDE.md §9 defines the system as 'analysis-only' and explicitly forbids automated trading, signal execution, decision triggering, and order generation. §4 confirms Phase D (Live Execution Gate) is 'blocked'. §10 forbids claiming 'Execution is available' without explicit proof. This negative guard is directly and strongly verified by multiple constitutional sections.
notes: No component may simulate or imply execution capability (§9 critical rule)

claims.classification_rationale: Layer-2 and Layer-3 are constitutional vocabulary embedded throughout CLAUDE.md and all canonical documents. The request explicitly states this is NOT a semantic rename or constitutional amendment, so existing terminology must be preserved. Memory confirms these are key architectural terms with prior rejected alternatives ('truth_store', 'decision_layer').
notes: CLAUDE.md §16.1 constitutional amendment rule applies to terminology changes
